source: Li Z., Zhang L., Li L., Huang B., Yuan H. Performance and characteristics analysis on the Starship aerodynamic configuration. Acta Aerodynamica Sinica 40(5):1-14 (2022). DOI 10.7638/kqdlxxb-2022.0011
method: Steady RANS, SST turbulence, Roe flux with MUSCL/min-mod, adiabatic no-slip walls, ~2e6 cells; turbulence model validated on S809 at high angle of attack. Geometry reconstructed from public information, not SpaceX data.
values_from: Article text and tables 1-3. Figure-only values (C_l_beta, C_n_beta, curves at X_cg 0.57/0.60) are not transcribed.

geometry.flaps: four trapezoidal flaps of uniform thickness with round leading edges; no vertical or belly fin
geometry.forward_flap_hinge: tangent to the nose-cap generatrix (inclined to the body axis)
geometry.deflection_definition: dihedral angle, positive upward, viewed nose to tail

references.area_ref: body base area (pi * 4.5^2 = 63.6 m2 for 9 m diameter)

longitudinal.statement: max C_L near 50 deg; max C_D near 90 deg; max L/D 1.5-1.7 at 10-20 deg
max C_L at 40-50 deg; max C_D at 90 deg; max L/D 1.7-1.9 at 10-20 deg
max C_L about 4-6 at 40-50 deg; C_L near zero at 90 deg; C_D max 6-11 over 80-120 deg; C_D 9.5-11 at 90 deg; max L/D 3.0-3.3 near 12 deg

trim.statement: forward pair alone trims within 70 deg; aft deflection extends trim above 90 deg
forward pair alone trims 65-89 deg; aft pair at 80 deg dihedral extends trim to 120 deg; subsonic trim efficiency lower overall

static_stability.statement: C_m_alpha < 0 (stable) at 60-70 deg for all forward dihedral 0-80 deg; unstable below about 20 deg
stable 60-90 deg, smaller |C_m_alpha| than at Ma 12

lateral_directional.statement: C_n_beta > 0 over a wide alpha range: statically directional-unstable
heading is controlled by bank-to-turn about the velocity vector; roll and yaw strongly coupled

flight_profile_statement: hypersonic 60-70 deg (about 15 min); supersonic at high alpha (about 2 g peak); subsonic near 90 deg (about 2 min); terminal phase by thrust vectoring
